name: Lying Leg Raise
steps: Lie on your back with your legs together and your palms beside your hips.
Brace your abs firmly to press your lower back down into the floor.
Lift both straight legs smoothly upward until they point roughly vertical toward the ceiling.
Lower your legs slowly and stop before your lower back begins to lift from the floor.
tips: Keep your lower back pressed against the floor throughout the descent; bend your knees slightly if your back begins to arch.
Control the lowering phase slowly rather than letting gravity drop your legs.
